items.title: Run shoptopless.com audience, monetization, health, and backlog baseline
items.summary: Produce a bounded read-only assessment of shoptopless.com using existing registry, analytics, SEO, revenue-attribution, compliance, operations, social, and AI-usage evidence. GA4 and Google Search Console are recorded as healthy; preserve unavailable audience, traffic, conversion, revenue, attribution, SEO, health, and cost fields as unknown. Do not infer telemetry, ROI, or causal lift.
items.requested_action: Review existing evidence only and document exactly one evidence-backed next action or blocker. Acceptance artifact: a timestamped assessment covering observable audience and content positioning, conversion paths, monetization readiness, health evidence, backlog priorities, measurement boundaries, and explicit unknowns. Rollback/follow-up boundary: no production rollback is required because no changes are authorized; follow-up is limited to documenting that single next action or blocker. Do not deploy, modify production, change credentials or configuration, request duplicate telemetry, spend money, or claim unavailable outcomes.
